description: Defines the Expression class with static methods for building SQL predicate expressions such as Equal, Like, GreaterThan, LessThan, In, And, Or, Not, Conjunction, and Disjunction, used for constructing SQL queries in GraphQL content management.

classes.name: Expression
classes.description: Provides static methods to create SQL predicate expressions for use in GraphQL queries within OrchardCore's content management system.

methods.name: Equal
methods.description: Creates a SimpleExpression representing an equality constraint on a property.

methods.name: Like
methods.description: Creates a LikeExpression for pattern matching with specified match options.

methods.name: GreaterThan
methods.description: Creates a SimpleExpression representing a 'greater than' constraint.

methods.name: GreaterThanOrEqual
methods.description: Creates a SimpleExpression representing a 'greater than or equal' constraint.

methods.name: LessThan
methods.description: Creates a SimpleExpression representing a 'less than' constraint.

methods.name: LessThanOrEqual
methods.description: Creates a SimpleExpression representing a 'less than or equal' constraint.

methods.name: In
methods.description: Creates an InExpression representing an 'in' constraint with multiple values.

methods.name: And
methods.description: Creates an AndExpression combining two predicates with logical AND.

methods.name: Or
methods.description: Creates an OrExpression combining two predicates with logical OR.

methods.name: Not
methods.description: Creates a NotExpression negating a predicate.

methods.name: Conjunction
methods.description: Creates a Conjunction group for combining expressions with AND.

methods.name: Disjunction
methods.description: Creates a Disjunction group for combining expressions with OR.
